column1: # Everyday Japanese (身の回りの日本語) — vocabulary.
# id|japanese|reading|english|part of speech|picture|categories|nuance|romaji override
# japanese  Furigana notation: each kanji run is followed by its kana in (),
#           e.g. 改札口(かいさつぐち), 買(か)い物(もの)かご. Katakana needs none.
# reading   The whole word in kana (katakana stays katakana). Spaces mark word
#           breaks for the romaji only. Must equal the furigana spelled out.
# picture   One emoji (Unicode 13 or older, so Windows 10 draws it), or
#           svg:<id> for a hand-drawn picture (src/pages/EverydayTrainer/art),
#           or photo:<file> for a photo in public/everyday/ (needs a row in
#           credits.tsv). Leave EMPTY when no verified picture exists yet —
#           never a stand-in. A picture may be used by one word only.
# categories Comma list of category ids. One word = one record, even when it
#           appears in several places (エレベーター is in five categories).
# nuance    One short line, or empty.
# romaji    Leave empty: romaji is derived from the reading (Hepburn, macrons
#           for long vowels). Fill only when the derived form would mislead.
# JLPT level is NOT written here. The generator looks each word up in
# scripts/levels/jlptWordLevels.tsv and writes "unclassified" when it is not
# on the list — never a guessed level.
# ---- At Home 家の中 ----
door|ドア|ドア|Door|noun|🚪|home,train|A hinged or sliding door; 戸(と) is the older word, still used for sliding doors.|
window|窓(まど)|まど|Window|noun|🪟|home,train||
ceiling|天井(てんじょう)|てんじょう|Ceiling|noun||home||
floor|床(ゆか)|ゆか|Floor|noun||home|The floor surface. "Second floor" of a building is 2階(にかい), not 床(ゆか).|
wall|壁(かべ)|かべ|Wall|noun||home||
stairs|階段(かいだん)|かいだん|Stairs|noun|svg:stairs|home,apartment,station||
genkan|玄関(げんかん)|げんかん|Entryway (genkan)|noun||home,apartment|The sunken entry where shoes come off before stepping up into the home.|
shoe-cabinet|下駄箱(げたばこ)|げたばこ|Shoe cabinet|noun||home,school|Still called 下駄箱(げたばこ) though nobody keeps geta in it; 靴箱(くつばこ) also common. At school it means the shoe lockers.|
hallway|廊下(ろうか)|ろうか|Hallway, corridor|noun||home,school,hospital|廊下(ろうか)を走(はし)らない — "no running in the hallway" is a classic school rule.|
light-switch|スイッチ|スイッチ|Light switch|noun|svg:light-switch|home|Japanese switches are often wide rocker plates.|
outlet|コンセント|コンセント|Power outlet|noun|svg:outlet|home,office|Japanese-English; "outlet" is not used. Plugs here have two flat pins.|
room-light|電気(でんき)|でんき|The lights (room light)|noun||home,living|電気(でんき)をつける / 消(け)す — the everyday way to say turn the lights on / off.|
light-bulb|電球(でんきゅう)|でんきゅう|Light bulb|noun|💡|home|電球(でんきゅう)が切(き)れた — the bulb has burned out.|
tatami|畳(たたみ)|たたみ|Tatami mat|noun|svg:tatami|home|Rooms are measured in tatami: a 6畳(ろくじょう) room is about 10 m².|
shoji|障子(しょうじ)|しょうじ|Paper sliding screen|noun|svg:shoji|home|Wooden lattice covered with paper; lets light in through the window side.|
fusuma|襖(ふすま)|ふすま|Sliding room divider|noun||home|Opaque sliding panels between rooms and on 押(お)し入(い)れ closets.|
key|鍵(かぎ)|かぎ|Key; lock|noun|🔑|home,apartment|Means both key and lock: 鍵(かぎ)をかける = to lock.|
trash-can|ゴミ箱(ばこ)|ゴミばこ|Trash can|noun|🗑️|home,kitchen,park,konbini|Public bins are rare in Japan; at konbini they are split by type.|
clock|時計(とけい)|とけい|Clock; watch|noun|🕰️|home,living|Covers both wall clocks and wristwatches (腕時計(うでどけい)).|
air-conditioner|エアコン|エアコン|Air conditioner|noun|svg:air-conditioner|home,living,bedroom,office|Japanese units heat as well as cool. Remote mode 冷房(れいぼう) = cooling, 暖房(だんぼう) = heating.|
umbrella-stand|傘立(かさた)て|かさたて|Umbrella stand|noun|svg:umbrella-stand|home,konbini,office|Found at shop and office entrances; some have locks.|
breaker|ブレーカー|ブレーカー|Circuit breaker|noun||home|ブレーカーが落(お)ちる — the breaker trips (common with Japan's low amperage contracts).|
fire-alarm|火災報知器(かさいほうちき)|かさい ほうちき|Fire alarm|noun||home,school,office|The everyday word; the home smoke detector is formally 住宅用火災警報器(じゅうたくようかさいけいほうき).|
storm-shutter|雨戸(あまど)|あまど|Storm shutter|noun||home|Sliding shutters closed at night or before a typhoon.|
oshiire|押(お)し入(い)れ|おしいれ|Futon closet|noun||home,bedroom|Deep closet with a middle shelf, made for storing futons. Western closets are クローゼット.|
# ---- Apartment マンション・アパート ----
elevator|エレベーター|エレベーター|Elevator|noun|🛗|apartment,station,airport,office,hospital,mall||
mailbox|郵便受(ゆうびんう)け|ゆうびんうけ|Mailbox (at home)|noun|📫|apartment|The box you receive mail in. The red street box you post in is ポスト.|
parcel-locker|宅配(たくはい)ボックス|たくはい ボックス|Parcel locker|noun|svg:parcel-locker|apartment|Lockers in the lobby where couriers leave packages when nobody is home.|
intercom|インターホン|インターホン|Intercom|noun|svg:intercom|apartment|Japanese-English; most have a camera screen inside.|
auto-lock|オートロック|オートロック|Auto-lock entrance|noun||apartment|A lobby door only residents can open; visitors call from the panel.|
balcony|ベランダ|ベランダ|Balcony|noun||apartment|The usual word for an apartment balcony; バルコニー is used in listings.|
insect-screen|網戸(あみど)|あみど|Insect screen|noun|svg:insect-screen|apartment|A sliding mesh window that keeps mosquitoes out in summer.|
vent-fan|換気扇(かんきせん)|かんきせん|Ventilation fan|noun|svg:ventfan|apartment,kitchen,bathroom||
water-heater|給湯器(きゅうとうき)|きゅうとうき|Water heater|noun||apartment|Usually a gas unit outside the door or on the balcony, run from a panel in the kitchen.|
building-manager|管理人(かんりにん)|かんりにん|Building manager|noun||apartment||
landlord|大家(おおや)さん|おおやさん|Landlord|noun||apartment|Almost always said with さん.|ōya-san
laundry-pole|物干(ものほ)し竿(ざお)|ものほしざお|Laundry pole|noun|svg:laundry-pole|apartment|The pole on the balcony for hanging laundry to dry.|
garbage-point|ゴミ置(お)き場(ば)|ゴミ おきば|Garbage collection point|noun||apartment,street|Put bags out only on the right day for each type of garbage.|
notice-board|掲示板(けいじばん)|けいじばん|Notice board|noun|svg:notice-board|apartment,school,office|Also used for online message boards.|
emergency-exit|非常口(ひじょうぐち)|ひじょうぐち|Emergency exit|noun|svg:emergency-exit|apartment,airport,office,hospital,school,mall|The green running-figure sign was designed in Japan.|
fire-extinguisher|消火器(しょうかき)|しょうかき|Fire extinguisher|noun|🧯|apartment,office,school||
bicycle-parking|駐輪場(ちゅうりんじょう)|ちゅうりんじょう|Bicycle parking|noun||apartment,station,supermarket|Bikes left outside marked areas can be removed by the city.|
parking-lot|駐車場(ちゅうしゃじょう)|ちゅうしゃじょう|Parking lot|noun|🅿️|apartment,supermarket,hospital,mall||
spare-key|合鍵(あいかぎ)|あいかぎ|Spare key|noun||apartment||
floor-plan|間取(まど)り|まどり|Floor plan|noun||apartment|Written like 2LDK: two rooms plus living, dining and kitchen.|
nameplate|表札(ひょうさつ)|ひょうさつ|Door nameplate|noun||apartment|Many people now leave it blank for privacy.|
# ---- Kitchen 台所 ----
sink|流(なが)し|ながし|Kitchen sink|noun||kitchen|シンク is also common.|
faucet|蛇口(じゃぐち)|じゃぐち|Faucet, tap|noun|svg:faucet|kitchen,bathroom,park|蛇口(じゃぐち)をひねる — turn the tap.|
stove|コンロ|コンロ|Stove burner, cooktop|noun|svg:gas-stove|kitchen|ガスコンロ or IHコンロ. ストーブ means a room heater in Japanese, not a cooker.|
fridge|冷蔵庫(れいぞうこ)|れいぞうこ|Refrigerator|noun|svg:fridge|kitchen||
freezer|冷凍庫(れいとうこ)|れいとうこ|Freezer|noun||kitchen||
microwave|電子(でんし)レンジ|でんし レンジ|Microwave oven|noun|svg:microwave|kitchen,konbini|Often just レンジ. Casual verb: チンする — to microwave.|
rice-cooker|炊飯器(すいはんき)|すいはんき|Rice cooker|noun|svg:ricecooker|kitchen||
kettle|やかん|やかん|Kettle (stovetop)|noun||kitchen|An electric one is 電気(でんき)ケトル.|
pot|鍋(なべ)|なべ|Pot, saucepan|noun|svg:pot|kitchen|Also the name for hot-pot dishes cooked at the table.|
frying-pan|フライパン|フライパン|Frying pan|noun|🍳|kitchen||
kitchen-knife|包丁(ほうちょう)|ほうちょう|Kitchen knife|noun|🔪|kitchen|The 🔪 emoji's official name is "hocho".|
cutting-board|まな板(いた)|まないた|Cutting board|noun|svg:cutting-board|kitchen||
ladle|お玉(たま)|おたま|Ladle|noun|svg:ladle|kitchen|Short for お玉杓子(たまじゃくし), which also means "tadpole".|
cooking-chopsticks|菜箸(さいばし)|さいばし|Cooking chopsticks|noun||kitchen|Long chopsticks for cooking and serving, not for eating.|
dish-cabinet|食器棚(しょっきだな)|しょっきだな|Dish cabinet|noun||kitchen||
drying-rack|水切(みずき)りかご|みずきりかご|Dish drying rack|noun||kitchen||
sink-corner|三角(さんかく)コーナー|さんかく コーナー|Sink-corner strainer|noun||kitchen|A triangular basket in the sink corner for food scraps.|
sponge|スポンジ|スポンジ|Sponge|noun|🧽|kitchen||
plastic-wrap|ラップ|ラップ|Plastic wrap|noun||kitchen|Cling film. ラップする = to cover with wrap.|
fish-grill|魚焼(さかなや)きグリル|さかなやき グリル|Fish grill|noun||kitchen|The narrow grill drawer under most Japanese gas stoves.|
food-waste|生(なま)ゴミ|なまゴミ|Food waste|noun||kitchen|Kitchen scraps; collected with burnable garbage in most towns.|
# ---- Bathroom 浴室・トイレ ----
bathtub|浴槽(よくそう)|よくそう|Bathtub|noun|🛁|bathroom|In speech often お風呂(ふろ) or 湯船(ゆぶね). Wash before getting in.|
shower|シャワー|シャワー|Shower|noun|🚿|bathroom||
bath-drain|排水口(はいすいこう)|はいすいこう|Drain (sink, bath)|noun||bathroom|The drain hole. Same reading as 排水溝(はいすいこう), a drainage channel.|
washbasin|洗面台(せんめんだい)|せんめんだい|Washbasin, vanity|noun||bathroom|The room around it is the 洗面所(せんめんじょ).|
mirror|鏡(かがみ)|かがみ|Mirror|noun|🪞|bathroom,mall||
toilet|トイレ|トイレ|Toilet, restroom|noun|🚽|bathroom,park,station,konbini|Means both the room and the fixture. お手洗(てあら)い is politer.|
toilet-bowl|便器(べんき)|べんき|Toilet bowl|noun||bathroom|The fixture itself, used in cleaning and repairs.|
bidet-seat|温水洗浄便座(おんすいせんじょうべんざ)|おんすい せんじょう べんざ|Bidet toilet seat|noun||bathroom|Usually called by the brand name ウォシュレット.|
toilet-paper|トイレットペーパー|トイレットペーパー|Toilet paper|noun|🧻|bathroom||
toothbrush|歯(は)ブラシ|は ブラシ|Toothbrush|noun|🪥|bathroom||
toothpaste|歯磨(はみが)き粉(こ)|はみがきこ|Toothpaste|noun||bathroom||
towel|タオル|タオル|Towel|noun||bathroom|A bath towel is バスタオル.|
soap|石鹸(せっけん)|せっけん|Soap|noun|🧼|bathroom||
shampoo|シャンプー|シャンプー|Shampoo|noun||bathroom|Conditioner is リンス or コンディショナー.|
wash-bowl|洗面器(せんめんき)|せんめんき|Bath bowl|noun|svg:wash-bowl|bathroom|The small basin for scooping water over yourself in a Japanese bath.|
bath-stool|風呂椅子(ふろいす)|ふろいす|Bath stool|noun|svg:bath-stool|bathroom|You sit on it to wash, before getting into the tub.|
reheat|追(お)い焚(だ)き|おいだき|Bath reheat (button)|noun||bathroom|The panel button that warms the bath water back up.|
changing-area|脱衣所(だついじょ)|だついじょ|Changing area (by the bath)|noun||bathroom|In most homes it doubles as the laundry and washbasin area.|
washing-machine|洗濯機(せんたくき)|せんたくき|Washing machine|noun|svg:washer|bathroom||
hair-dryer|ドライヤー|ドライヤー|Hair dryer|noun||bathroom||
mold|カビ|カビ|Mold|noun||bathroom|Usually written in katakana. カビ取(と)り = mold remover.|
# ---- Living Room リビング ----
sofa|ソファー|ソファー|Sofa|noun|🛋️|living|Also written ソファ.|
remote|リモコン|リモコン|Remote control|noun|svg:remote|living|From "remote control".|
curtain|カーテン|カーテン|Curtain|noun||living,bedroom||
tv|テレビ|テレビ|Television|noun|📺|living||
coffee-table|ローテーブル|ローテーブル|Coffee table, low table|noun||living|An older-style low table is ちゃぶ台(だい).|
kotatsu|こたつ|こたつ|Kotatsu (heated table)|noun|svg:kotatsu|living|A low table with a heater underneath and a quilt over it.|
zabuton|座布団(ざぶとん)|ざぶとん|Floor cushion|noun|svg:zabuton|living||
legless-chair|座椅子(ざいす)|ざいす|Legless chair|noun||living|A chair with a back but no legs, for sitting on the floor.|
carpet|カーペット|カーペット|Carpet|noun||living|A small one is ラグ.|
bookshelf|本棚(ほんだな)|ほんだな|Bookshelf|noun||living||
houseplant|観葉植物(かんようしょくぶつ)|かんよう しょくぶつ|Houseplant|noun|🪴|living,office||
humidifier|加湿器(かしつき)|かしつき|Humidifier|noun||living,bedroom|Common in dry Japanese winters.|
electric-fan|扇風機(せんぷうき)|せんぷうき|Electric fan|noun|svg:electric-fan|living||
space-heater|ストーブ|ストーブ|Space heater|noun|svg:heater|living|A room heater (often kerosene), not a kitchen stove.|
vacuum|掃除機(そうじき)|そうじき|Vacuum cleaner|noun|svg:vacuum|living|掃除機(そうじき)をかける — to vacuum.|
newspaper|新聞(しんぶん)|しんぶん|Newspaper|noun|📰|living||
tissues|ティッシュ|ティッシュ|Tissues|noun||living,bedroom|Short for ティッシュペーパー. Free packs are handed out on the street.|
floor-heating|床暖房(ゆかだんぼう)|ゆかだんぼう|Underfloor heating|noun||living||
air-purifier|空気清浄機(くうきせいじょうき)|くうき せいじょうき|Air purifier|noun||living||
# ---- Bedroom 寝室 ----
pillow|枕(まくら)|まくら|Pillow|noun||bedroom||
blanket|毛布(もうふ)|もうふ|Blanket|noun||bedroom||
comforter|掛(か)け布団(ぶとん)|かけぶとん|Comforter, duvet|noun||bedroom|The top quilt of a futon set.|
futon-mattress|敷布団(しきぶとん)|しきぶとん|Futon mattress|noun||bedroom|The mattress laid on the floor. Also written 敷(し)き布団(ぶとん).|
futon|布団(ふとん)|ふとん|Futon (bedding)|noun||bedroom|The whole bedding set. 布団(ふとん)を敷(し)く = lay it out; 布団(ふとん)を干(ほ)す = air it in the sun.|
mattress|マットレス|マットレス|Mattress|noun||bedroom||
bed|ベッド|ベッド|Bed|noun|🛏️|bedroom,hospital||
bed-sheet|シーツ|シーツ|Bed sheet|noun||bedroom|Also used for a single sheet.|
alarm-clock|目覚(めざ)まし時計(どけい)|めざまし どけい|Alarm clock|noun|⏰|bedroom|時計(とけい) becomes どけい here. Often just 目覚(めざ)まし.|

hanger|ハンガー|ハンガー|Clothes hanger|noun|svg:hanger|bedroom||
chest-of-drawers|タンス|タンス|Chest of drawers|noun||bedroom|Also written 箪笥(たんす). A drawer is 引(ひ)き出(だ)し.|

desk-lamp|電気(でんき)スタンド|でんき スタンド|Desk lamp|noun||bedroom,office|Japanese-English: "stand" here means a lamp.|

# ---- Street 道路・街中 ----
curb|縁石(えんせき)|えんせき|Curb|noun||street|Also read ふちいし.|
guardrail|ガードレール|ガードレール|Guardrail|noun|svg:guardrail|street||
pothole|道路(どうろ)の穴(あな)|どうろ の あな|Pothole|noun||street|There is no common one-word term; ポットホール is technical. Also 道路(どうろ)の陥没(かんぼつ) for a sunken road.|

drainage-channel|排水溝(はいすいこう)|はいすいこう|Drainage channel, gutter|noun||street|A drain channel. Same reading as 排水口(はいすいこう), the drain hole in a sink.|
crosswalk|横断歩道(おうだんほどう)|おうだん ほどう|Pedestrian crossing|noun|svg:crosswalk|street||
overpass|歩道橋(ほどうきょう)|ほどうきょう|Pedestrian overpass|noun||street||
utility-pole|電柱(でんちゅう)|でんちゅう|Utility pole|noun|svg:utility-pole|street|Most Japanese power lines still run overhead on these.|
power-line|電線(でんせん)|でんせん|Power line|noun||street||
traffic-light|信号(しんごう)|しんごう|Traffic light|noun|🚥|street|Japanese call the green light 青(あお), "blue".|
sidewalk|歩道(ほどう)|ほどう|Sidewalk|noun||street||
roadway|車道(しゃどう)|しゃどう|Roadway (for cars)|noun||street||
intersection|交差点(こうさてん)|こうさてん|Intersection|noun||street||
tactile-paving|点字(てんじ)ブロック|てんじ ブロック|Tactile paving|noun|svg:tactile-paving|street,station|Yellow raised tiles that guide blind pedestrians. Don't stand or park bikes on them.|
curve-mirror|カーブミラー|カーブミラー|Convex traffic mirror|noun|svg:curve-mirror|street|Round mirrors at blind corners; everywhere in Japanese side streets.|
vending-machine|自動販売機(じどうはんばいき)|じどう はんばいき|Vending machine|noun|svg:vending-machine|street,park,station,office,hospital|Usually shortened to 自販機(じはんき).|

streetlight|街灯(がいとう)|がいとう|Streetlight|noun|svg:streetlight|street,park||

traffic-cone|カラーコーン|カラーコーン|Traffic cone|noun|svg:traffic-cone|street|Japanese-English (originally a brand name); パイロン is also used.|

fire-hydrant|消火栓(しょうかせん)|しょうかせん|Fire hydrant|noun||street|Often underground in Japan, under a marked cover.|

lawn|芝生(しばふ)|しばふ|Lawn, grass|noun||park|Sign: 芝生(しばふ)に入(はい)らないでください — keep off the grass.|
